ah.weight_note_zh: 层内权重随价格漂移（季内不调仓）
ah.weight_note_en: Intra-sleeve weights drift with prices (no rebalance intra-quarter)

ah.note_zh: AH 季频调仓（3/6/9/12 月末信号，次月首个交易日执行）；本月持有缓冲，无需调整。
ah.note_en: AH rebalances quarterly (Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec); hold buffer this month — no change.

incentive.note_zh: 月频增量：公告后首个可交易月纳入，持有 9 个月；总敞口超 15% 时等比压缩。
incentive.note_en: Monthly incremental: first tradable month after announcement, 9M hold; scale to 15% cap.

rules_zh: 复合策略：AH折价 50%（季频 3/6/9/12 月末 + Top15 持有缓冲，层内权重漂移）+ 红利/创业板 30% + 股权激励月频增量 2%/笔（公告后首个可交易月纳入，9 个月，15% cap）。
Top20 为组合穿透权重（AH/行业层内已含价格漂移）；月底分三层展示调入/调出或「无需调整」。
rules_en: Composite: AH 50% (quarterly Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec + hold buffer, intra-sleeve drift) + Div/ChiNext 30% + monthly incremental incentive 2% (first tradable month, 9M, 15% cap).
Top 20 = look-through weights (AH/industry sleeves include price drift); month-end panel shows per-sleeve entries/exits or hold-buffer notes.

etf.execution_note: Month-end momentum ranking; trades execute on the next month's first trading day at 50/50 when the selected ETF set changes; weights drift naturally otherwise with no monthly rebalance.

dividend.execution_note: 月末信号，次月首个交易日调仓；仅当持仓变化时交易；成本30bps

equity.execution_note: Daily event-driven entries at 7% per slot; displayed weights drift with prices since entry (no intra-hold rebalance).
rules_zh: 事件：股权激励 strict core；员工持股仅限「X年/第N期员工持股计划（草案）」。
ESOP 入场：公告后首个可交易日收盘价买入，且 close > MA200（涨停日顺延）。
股权激励：公告后首个可交易日收盘价买入（涨停日顺延）。
持有 9 个月；单票 7%，最多 14 槽；满员时卖出 MA200 下方存量（优先表现最差）腾位。
rules_en: Events: equity incentive strict core; ESOP draft titles only.
ESOP entry: first tradable day close after announcement, close > MA200; skip limit-up days.
Equity incentive entry: first tradable day close after announcement; skip limit-up days.
Hold 9 months; 7% per slot, max 14; when full, sell MA200-below holdings (worst first) to fund new names.
